items.desc: Shafaq News- Baghdad Breast cancer accounts for 22.7% of cancer diagnoses among women in Iraq and remains one of the country’s leading causes of cancer-related deaths, according to 2026 Health Ministry data. Figures presented at Cihan University-Erbil earlier this month recorded 9,043 breast cancer cases in Iraq in 2026, accounting for 19.5% of the 46,682 cancer cases registered nationwide.
